author: Govinda Acharya
review_text: I have been using eSewa for a long time, but recently it has failed to maintain its reliability. I needed to send a small amount of money to a bank account, and although I attempted the transfer, the app repeatedly showed the message, “An error occurred, try again later.” I tried four times, and only later discovered that the money had actually been sent all four times. Moreover, I was charged Rs. 10 for each transaction that appeared to have failed, even though they were successful.
